title: Harry Carney driving for Duke
summary: Carney was quiet and liked to drive, a good match for Ellington, who did not want conversation.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Carney Connie used to tell me stories about Duke. They used to drive, and he said Duke wouldn't like for you to talk, you know, he says, because he's getting his ideas together. He said one reason Duke liked for him to go with him because he kept quite, quiet. He didn't like to talk anyway. Carney Connie was quiet, you know. He said -- so, they were a perfect match. And he liked to drive, Connie liked to drive so.
I don't know how he did it
would have like a 12 hour drive between dates. Harry would drive 12 hours and then he'd go on stage and play. He didn't seem to ever sleep.
But he just had that stamina.
Duke didn't sleep a lot, you know.
No, Duke liked to navigate. He would-- you know he insisted (inaudible) Harry couldn't have made it if he wasn't telling Harry where to --
